new.name: Herring Flatwing
new.description: A long, slender flatwing for striped bass that uses saddle hackles tied flat over bucktail to suggest a herring.
new.fishing_tips: Swing and drift it in current; let the long hackles do the work.
mats: Long white and blue saddle hackles, tied flat
steps: Tie a sparse white bucktail underwing.
Tie long saddles flat on top with flash between.
Add a topping of peacock herl.
Build a small head and add eyes.

new.name: Dark Mackerel
new.description: A sea trout and saltwater fly with a silver body, a blue-black wing and a hackle collar, after the mackerel pattern of the British coast.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it at night or dusk on a slow swing for sea trout.
mats: Flat silver tinsel with oval silver rib
steps: Tie in the tail and rib.
Wind flat silver tinsel and rib it.
Tie in a beard hackle under the hook.
Tie in the wing and finish a neat head.

new.name: Snapping Shrimp
new.description: A bonefish shrimp with a craft fur tail, mono eyes and a body of palmered hackle under a resin shellback.
new.fishing_tips: Long leader, short strips, and stop as soon as the fish tips down.
mats: Tan craft fur and copper flash
Tan dubbing with palmered grizzly hackle
steps: Tie bead chain at the eye.
Add the tail and mono eyes at the bend.
Dub the body, palmer the hackle and trim the top.
Coat the top with UV resin.

new.name: Simple Squid
new.description: An easy squid with long hackle tentacles, a craft fur mantle and large eyes for striped bass and bluefish.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it at night near jetties with long, slow pulls.
mats: White saddle hackles and pink Krystal Flash
steps: Tie long hackles at the bend for tentacles.
Glue large eyes near the bend.
Tie craft fur in reverse and fold it back for the mantle.
Coat the thread wraps.

new.name: Tarpon Shrimp
new.description: A tarpon fly in shrimp colours with a long splayed tail, a palmered hackle collar and burnt mono eyes.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in channels with slow, steady strips on a floating or intermediate line.
mats: Tan and grizzly saddle hackles, splayed
steps: Tie in splayed hackles and flash at the bend.
Add the mono eyes.
Palmer the schlappen collar.
Build a neat thread head.

new.name: EP Roosterfish Mullet
new.description: A big mullet built from layered EP fibres with a dark back and large eyes, for roosterfish and jacks on the beach.
new.fishing_tips: Cast ahead of cruising fish and strip as fast as you can.
mats: Grey and dark olive EP fibres
steps: Tie EP fibres in bunches, top and bottom.
Add flash in the middle layers.
Comb and trim to a mullet shape.
Glue on large eyes.

new.name: Shannon's Terror
new.description: A night sea trout fly with a silver body, a dark wing and a jungle cock eye, made for slow swings in the dark.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on a slow swing through pools at night.
steps: Wind the silver body and rib.
Add a black beard hackle.
Tie in a black wing.
Add jungle cock cheeks and finish.

new.name: EP Minnow
new.description: A classic EP fibre baitfish tied in clumps and trimmed to shape, for striped bass, snook and most saltwater predators.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it through schools of bait; vary speed until fish commit.
steps: Tie EP fibres in small clumps on top and bottom.
Work forward, adding flash in the middle.
Trim to a tapered minnow.
Glue on eyes.

new.name: EP Shrimp
new.description: A durable shrimp made from EP fibres with mono eyes and a rubber leg antenna, a favourite for redfish and snook.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it slowly near grass and oyster bars.
mats: Tan EP fibres, tied in clumps
steps: Tie in antennae and eyes at the bend.
Tie EP fibre clumps forward.
Palmer hackle underneath.
Trim the body to a shrimp taper.

new.name: Bluegill Gurgler
new.description: A small foam gurgler with a marabou tail and rubber legs that spits and pops for bluegill and other panfish.
new.fishing_tips: Cast near cover, let the rings fade, then give it tiny pops.
steps: Tie in the marabou tail.
Tie in the foam at the bend and wrap chenille forward.
Fold the foam over and tie down, leaving a lip.
Add legs at the tie-down point.

new.name: Double Deceiver
new.description: An articulated Lefty's Deceiver with two hooks joined by wire, long saddle feathers and a bucktail collar, for pike, musky and striped bass.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it with long pulls and pauses; it breathes on the stop.
steps: Tie a Deceiver on the rear hook with saddles and bucktail.
Join it to the front hook with wire.
Tie a second bucktail collar on the front hook.
Add eyes and finish.

new.name: Double Gonga
new.description: An articulated version of the Gonga with two rabbit-and-dubbing sections and a sculpin head, for big trout.
new.fishing_tips: Strip and pause along banks and drop-offs.
steps: Tie the rear section with rabbit and dubbing.
Connect it to the front hook with wire.
Tie the front section the same way.
Add eyes and trim a wide sculpin head.

new.name: Gonga
new.description: A single-hook sculpin streamer with a rabbit tail, dubbed body and a wide head, for trout and smallmouth.
new.fishing_tips: Swing and strip it near the bottom.
steps: Tie on the eyes.
Tie in the rabbit tail.
Dub the body with legs along the sides.
Dub a wide head and trim it flat.

new.name: Foam Frog
new.description: A simple foam frog with rubber legs that sits flat on the water, for bass in pads and grass.
new.fishing_tips: Twitch it over pads and let it sit.
steps: Cut a frog shape from layered foam.
Glue and tie the foam to the shank.
Tie in rubber legs at the rear and front.
Add eyes.

new.name: STP Frog
new.description: A low-profile frog with a foam body and long legs that kick on the strip.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it in short pops along grass edges.
steps: Tie in the weed guard.
Tie in the legs at the bend.
Tie down the foam body.
Add eyes and close the weed guard.

new.name: Golden Darter
new.description: A classic feather-wing streamer with a gold body, yellow wing feathers and a jungle cock eye.
new.fishing_tips: Troll or strip it for brook trout and landlocked salmon.
steps: Tie in the tail and rib.
Wind the gold body and rib.
Add the throat.
Tie in the wing, cheeks and finish a neat head.

new.name: Bloody Black Leech
new.description: A black mohair leech with a red butt and a bead head, a standby for stillwater trout.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it slowly on an intermediate line.
steps: Slide on the bead.
Tie in the marabou tail.
Dub a red butt.
Wrap mohair forward and brush it out.

new.name: Jigged Mini Leech
new.description: A small leech on a jig hook with a marabou tail and a tungsten bead, for euro nymphing and stillwater.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on a tight line or under an indicator.
steps: Slide on the bead.
Tie in a short marabou tail.
Dub a slim body.
Finish behind the bead.

new.name: Murray's Madtom
new.description: A smallmouth streamer that imitates a madtom catfish, with a dark marabou tail, a chenille body and a deer hair head.
new.fishing_tips: Drift it along the bottom in riffles and pools.
mats: Deer hair, spun and trimmed flat
steps: Wrap lead wire on the shank.
Tie in the tail.
Wrap the chenille body.
Spin a deer hair head and trim it flat.

new.name: Nine-Three
new.description: A classic feather-wing streamer with a silver body, a green and black wing and a jungle cock eye, for trout and landlocked salmon.
new.fishing_tips: Troll it or strip it in lakes at ice-out.
mats: White bucktail under two green hackles and one black hackle
steps: Wind a silver tinsel body.
Tie in white bucktail.
Add green hackles flat, then a black hackle on top.
Add cheeks and finish.

new.name: Polar Fibre Minnow
new.description: A simple baitfish from layered polar fibre with flash and eyes, for bass, pike, trout and salt.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it through schools of baitfish.
steps: Tie in white fibre on the bottom.
Tie in olive fibre on top with flash between.
Shape the head and coat with resin.
Add eyes.

new.name: Golden Shiner
new.description: A gold-and-white bass streamer that suggests a golden shiner, with bucktail, flash and a short head.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it along weed lines for largemouth.
steps: Tie in white bucktail on the bottom.
Add gold flash.
Tie gold and olive bucktail on top.
Add eyes and coat the head.

new.name: TeQueely
new.description: A weighted streamer with a marabou tail, a chenille body, rubber legs and a palmered hackle, for trout and bass.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it with jerks and pauses.
steps: Wrap lead wire.
Tie in the tail.
Tie in hackle and chenille and wrap forward.
Add rubber legs and palmer the hackle.

new.name: Warden's Worry
new.description: An old-time streamer with a red tail, an orange body, a brown bucktail wing and a yellow throat.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it through runs for brook trout.
steps: Tie in the tail and rib.
Dub and rib the body.
Add the throat.
Tie in the wing and finish.

new.name: Cheech Leech
new.description: A leech with a cone head, a marabou tail and a long schlappen collar that undulates on the strip.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on a sinking line with long, slow strips.
steps: Slide on the cone.
Tie in the marabou tail.
Dub the body.
Wind the schlappen collar.

new.name: Bumble Puppy
new.description: A classic attractor streamer with a white body, a red butt and a white bucktail wing.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it through runs for trout and bass.
steps: Tie in the tail.
Wrap the red butt then the white body.
Tie in the wing.
Wind the hackle and finish.

new.name: Easy Foam Hopper
new.description: A simple foam hopper or cricket with rubber legs that floats high all day.
new.fishing_tips: Slap it down near grassy banks in summer.
steps: Tie in the foam at the bend.
Fold it forward in segments.
Add the elk wing.
Tie in rubber legs.

new.name: Baetis Nymph
new.description: A slim olive mayfly nymph with a pheasant tail tail, a thread or dubbed abdomen and a dark wing case, for blue-winged olive hatches.
new.fishing_tips: Drift it deep before and during BWO hatches.
steps: Slide on the bead and tie in the tail.
Build a slim abdomen and rib it.
Tie in the wing case and dub the thorax.
Pull the wing case over and finish.

new.name: Batman Nymph
new.description: A dark attractor nymph with a peacock body, a purple flash wing case and a bead head.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it as the top fly in a two-nymph rig.
steps: Slide on the bead and tie in the tail.
Wrap peacock and rib it.
Tie in the wing case and legs.
Pull the wing case over and finish.

new.name: Bead Head Egg
new.description: An egg fly built around a bead with yarn or dubbing, for trout below spawning fish.
new.fishing_tips: Dead-drift it near gravel redds without disturbing spawning fish.
steps: Slide on the bead.
Tie egg yarn around the bead.
Trim to a round egg.
Whip finish.

new.name: Brown Bivisible
new.description: An old attractor dry fly made of nothing but palmered brown hackle with a white hackle at the front so the angler can see it.
new.fishing_tips: Skate or dead-drift it in fast water.
steps: Tie in the tail.
Palmer brown hackle forward.
Add a white hackle at the front.
Whip finish.

new.name: Black Dose
new.description: A classic Atlantic salmon fly with a black body, silver rib and a dark wing.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it through pools in low water.
steps: Tie the tag and tail.
Wind the body and rib.
Add the hackle.
Tie in the wing and finish.

new.name: Acetate Bloodworm
new.description: A translucent red bloodworm with an acetate body that glows like a real midge larva.
new.fishing_tips: Hang it just off the bottom in lakes.
steps: Wrap thread on the shank.
Tie in the acetate and wrap it forward.
Add a small bead.
Finish.

new.name: Blue Dun
new.description: A traditional grey dry fly with a dun hackle and a muskrat body for olive and grey mayfly hatches.
new.fishing_tips: Drift it during cloudy hatches.
steps: Tie in the tail.
Dub the body.
Set the wings.
Wind the hackle.

new.name: Blue Quill
new.description: A small mayfly dry with a stripped quill body and a dun hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it to early season hatches.
steps: Tie in the tail.
Wrap the quill body.
Wind the hackle.
Finish.

new.name: Antonio's BWO Emerger
new.description: A tiny blue-winged olive emerger with a trailing shuck, a thread body and a puff of CDC that holds it in the surface film.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the film to risers that refuse a full dry during BWO hatches.
mats: Grey CDC, one or two feathers
steps: Tie in a short Z-lon shuck at the bend.
Build a thin, tapered thread body.
Tie in the CDC as a short loop or tuft over the thorax.
Dub a tiny thorax and whip finish.

new.name: Euro Caddis Larva
new.description: A bright green caddis larva on a jig hook with a tungsten bead, ribbed body and a dark thorax, made for tight-line nymphing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it close to the bottom in riffles where free-living caddis live.
steps: Slide on the bead and tie in the rib and shellback.
Dub a slim, slightly tapered green body.
Pull the shellback over and rib it in even turns.
Dub a short dark thorax behind the bead.

new.name: Grannom Soft Hackle
new.description: A soft hackle for the first caddis hatches of spring, with a green butt, a hare's fur body and a partridge collar.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it down and across during the grannom hatch.
steps: Tie in and wrap a short green butt.
Dub a tapered hare's fur body.
Tie in the partridge by the tip and wind two turns.
Build a small head and whip finish.

new.name: Light Cahill Wet
new.description: The wet version of the Light Cahill, with a cream body, ginger hen hackle and a wood duck wing, for summer evening hatches.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it just below the surface at dusk.
steps: Tie in a short wood duck tail.
Dub a slim cream body.
Tie in a ginger hen beard.
Tie a wood duck wing on top and finish the head.

new.name: Faded Chironomid
new.description: A stillwater chironomid pupa with a pale, faded body, a wire rib, a bead and white gills, matching freshly hatched midges.
new.fishing_tips: Hang it a foot off the bottom under an indicator.
steps: Tie in gills behind the bead and slide the bead over them.
Tie in the wire and build a slim tapered body.
Rib the body in even turns.
Coat with thin UV resin.

new.name: Copper Killer
new.description: A bright salmon fly with a copper tinsel body, an orange hackle and a red squirrel wing, popular in Newfoundland.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it on a floating line in clear, low water.
steps: Tie a short copper tag and tail.
Wind a smooth copper body.
Tie in the orange hackle as a beard.
Tie in the squirrel wing and finish a red head.

new.name: Mini Damsel
new.description: A small, simple damsel nymph with a marabou tail and a slim dubbed body.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it slowly near weed beds in early summer.
mats: Small bead chain or mono eyes
steps: Tie in the eyes behind the hook eye.
Tie in a marabou tail.
Dub a slim body.
Figure-eight dubbing around the eyes and finish.

new.name: Dark Cahill
new.description: A darker version of the Cahill dry with a grey body, wood duck wings and a brown hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it at dusk during darker mayfly hatches.
steps: Tie in and divide the wood duck wings.
Tie in the tail.
Dub a tapered body.
Wind the hackle around the wings.

new.name: Double Ephoron
new.description: A white fly (Ephoron) dry with two sets of white hackle on one hook, made to float high during the late summer white fly hatch.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it at dusk when the white flies are on the water.
mats: Two white hackles, one at the rear and one at the front
steps: Tie in the tail and wind a rear white hackle.
Dub a white body forward.
Wind a second white hackle at the front.
Trim the bottom flat if you want it to sit lower.

new.name: Ginger Quill Parachute
new.description: A parachute dry with a stripped quill body, a feather wing post and a ginger hackle, for light-coloured mayflies.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it to risers in slick water during summer hatches.
mats: Grey hen or mallard feather, folded as a post
steps: Tie in the feather wing post.
Tie in the tail and wrap the quill body.
Dub the thorax around the post.
Wind the hackle around the post and finish under it.

new.name: Grey Fox Emerger
new.description: An emerger version of the Grey Fox mayfly, with a trailing shuck, a fawn body and a short hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the film as the hatch starts.
mats: Grizzly and ginger, a few turns
steps: Tie in the shuck.
Dub a tapered body.
Tie in a short wing.
Wind a sparse hackle and finish.

new.name: Flashback Gammarus
new.description: A scud with a hare's ear body, a pearl flashback and a ribbed shell, for stillwater and spring creek trout.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it slowly near weed beds.
mats: Pearl flash with a clear shellback
Hare's ear dubbing, picked out underneath
steps: Add a few turns of lead.
Tie in the rib and the flash shellback.
Dub a full body and pick out legs underneath.
Pull the back over and rib it.

new.name: Gold Ribbed Hare's Ear
new.description: The classic unweighted Gold Ribbed Hare's Ear with a hare's mask tail, a buggy body, a gold rib and a turkey wing case.
new.fishing_tips: Drift it through riffles and runs; it suggests mayflies, caddis and scuds.
mats: Coarse hare's ear dubbing, picked out
steps: Tie in a short tail of guard hairs.
Dub a tapered abdomen and rib it with gold.
Tie in the turkey wing case.
Dub a rough thorax, pull the wing case over and pick out legs.

new.name: Haugur
new.description: An Icelandic salmon fly with a black body, a silver rib and a dark wing with a hot butt.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it on a floating line in Icelandic-style low water.
steps: Wind a short bright butt.
Wind the black body and rib it.
Add a black hackle.
Tie in a slim wing and finish the head.

new.name: Iron Blue Dun Wet
new.description: A small dark wet fly for the iron blue dun, with a claret-tipped body and a dark dun hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on cold, wet days when small dark mayflies hatch.
steps: Leave a short claret tag.
Dub a slim dark body.
Wind two turns of dark hackle.
Finish a small claret head.

new.name: Lady Amherst
new.description: A classic feather-wing Atlantic salmon fly with a silver body, layers of Lady Amherst pheasant tippet and a jungle cock eye.
new.fishing_tips: A display fly that still fishes; swing it in high water.
steps: Tie the tag and tail.
Wind the silver body and rib it.
Add the hackle.
Layer the tippet wing, add cheeks and finish.

new.name: Poxyback Microstone
new.description: A small stonefly nymph with a biot tail, a dubbed body and an epoxy-coated wing case.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in riffles in the winter and early spring.
steps: Tie in split biot tails.
Dub a tapered abdomen.
Tie in the wing case and legs.
Pull it over and coat with epoxy.

new.name: Mercer's Z-Wing Caddis
new.description: A caddis pupa with a dark wing, a shuck and an antron body.
new.fishing_tips: Swing or dead-drift it during caddis hatches.
steps: Slide on the bead and tie in the shuck.
Dub the body.
Tie in the wing along the sides.
Add partridge legs and finish.

new.name: Simple Midge Dry
new.description: A tiny adult midge with a thread body, a short white wing for visibility and a few turns of grizzly hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it to sipping trout on flat winter water, on 6X or 7X tippet.
mats: White Antron or poly yarn, tied short
steps: Wrap a thin, even thread body to the bend and back.
Tie in a short tuft of white yarn as a wing.
Tie in a small grizzly hackle and wind two or three turns.
Trim the wing short and whip finish.

new.name: White Moth
new.description: A bushy white dry fly for the moths that tumble onto Appalachian streams on summer evenings, with a dubbed body, a hair wing and white hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Skitter it across pools at dusk.
mats: White calf tail or deer hair, tied tent style
steps: Dub a full, tapered body.
Tie in a hair wing low over the body.
Tie in the hackle in front of the wing.
Wind the hackle and whip finish.

new.name: Pale Morning Dun
new.description: A classic PMD dry with a pale yellow body, light dun hackle and upright wings, for summer mayfly hatches in the West.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it upstream to risers during the PMD hatch, usually late morning.
mats: Light dun hackle tips or mallard slips
steps: Tie in and set the wings upright.
Tie in a tail as long as the body.
Dub a slim tapered body.
Wind the hackle behind and in front of the wings.

new.name: Partridge and Orange
new.description: A sparse North Country spider with an orange silk body and one or two turns of partridge, one of the oldest trout flies.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it during hatches or fish it upstream in a team of spiders.
steps: Wrap a slim silk body over the front two thirds of the shank.
Add a tiny hare's fur thorax if wanted.
Tie in a partridge feather by the tip.
Wind one or two turns and finish a small head.

new.name: Rat Faced McDougall
new.description: A Catskill dry fly with a spun and clipped deer hair body, grizzly hackle-tip wings and a ginger hackle, made to float in rough water.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in riffles and pocket water.
mats: Deer hair, spun and trimmed to a cigar shape
steps: Tie in a stiff tail.
Spin deer hair along the rear of the shank and trim to a cigar shape.
Tie in and divide the hackle-tip wings.
Wind the hackle and finish.

new.name: Red Ass Soft Hackle
new.description: A soft hackle with a bright red butt, a peacock herl body and a partridge collar.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it for trout and panfish; the red butt is a strong trigger.
steps: Wrap a short red butt at the bend.
Twist and wrap peacock herl forward.
Tie in partridge and wind two turns.
Finish a small head.

new.name: Silver Grey
new.description: A classic Atlantic salmon fly with a silver body, a badger hackle and a grey squirrel wing in its hairwing form.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it in clear water on bright days.
steps: Tie the tag and tail.
Wind the silver body and rib it.
Add the badger hackle.
Tie in the squirrel wing and finish.

new.name: Slate Drake
new.description: A large dark mayfly dry for the slate drake (Isonychia) hatch, with a dark grey body and dun hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the evening near riffles in summer and fall.
mats: Dark dun hackle tips or deer hair
steps: Set the wings.
Tie in the tail.
Dub a thick tapered body.
Wind the hackle.

new.name: Snaelda
new.description: An Icelandic tube fly with a body of brass or copper tube and long, spiralling bucktail or fox wing in hot colours.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it fast on a sinking tip for salmon and sea trout.
mats: Treble or single on a brass tube
Black, orange and yellow bucktail or fox
steps: Mount the tube and wrap the body.
Tie wing bunches around the tube.
Add a hen hackle collar.
Finish the head.

new.name: Endrick Spider
new.description: A Scottish soft hackle with a pheasant tail body, a gold rib and a partridge hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in a team of wet flies on lochs and rivers.
steps: Tie in the wire and pheasant fibres.
Wrap the body and rib it.
Tie in the partridge.
Wind two turns and finish.

new.name: Starling and Purple
new.description: A Yorkshire spider with a purple silk body and a starling hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it upstream in a team of spiders.
steps: Wrap a slim silk body.
Tie in the starling hackle.
Wind one or two turns.
Finish.

new.name: Sulphur No-Hackle Dun
new.description: A no-hackle sulphur with quill wings that sits flat in the film for picky trout.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it to selective trout in slow water.
steps: Tie in split tails.
Dub a slim body.
Tie in quill wings on the sides.
Dub a thorax around the wings.

new.name: Sulphur Soft Hackle
new.description: A sulphur or PMD soft hackle with a yellow body and a light hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it when sulphurs are emerging.
steps: Build a slim yellow body.
Dub a small thorax.
Wind the hackle.
Finish.

new.name: Ally's Shrimp Temple Dog
new.description: Ally's Shrimp tied in Temple Dog style on a tube, with layered fox and a long golden pheasant tail.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in high water for Atlantic salmon.
mats: Orange bucktail and golden pheasant tippet
Red and black floss with silver rib
steps: Tie in the tail.
Wind the two-part body.
Layer the wing.
Add the collar and finish.

new.name: Jigged Tailwater Sowbug
new.description: A sowbug on a jig hook with a tungsten bead, a dubbed body and a shell back.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep in tailwaters.
steps: Slide on the bead.
Tie in back and rib.
Dub the body.
Pull the back over and rib it.

new.name: Undertaker
new.description: A dark salmon fly with a green and orange butt, a black body and a black bear wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in dark water.
steps: Tie the tag and butt.
Wrap the body.
Rib it.
Tie in the wing.

new.name: Parawulff
new.description: A parachute Wulff with a calf hair post.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in riffles.
steps: Tie in the post.
Tie in the tail.
Dub the body.
Wind hackle around the post.

new.name: Bonefish Scampi
new.description: A shrimp for bonefish with a pearl braid body, bead chain eyes, and a wing of tan rabbit strip over pink craft fur that pulses even when the fly is still.
new.fishing_tips: Lead the fish, let it settle, then strip short and slow; the rabbit keeps moving on the pause.
steps: Tie the bead chain eyes on top of the shank near the eye so the fly rides point up.
Tie in a short pearl flash tail and wrap a braid body forward.
Tie in a sparse pink craft fur underwing with a few strands of Krystal Flash.
Tie a tan rabbit strip over the top, extending past the bend, and finish the head.

new.name: Albie Escort
new.description: A small, flashy baitfish for false albacore and bonito, with a hackle and Lateral Scale wing over an Estaz body and a hot-glue head with stick-on eyes.
new.fishing_tips: Cast into the blitz and strip as fast as you can.
steps: Wrap a short Estaz body behind the eye.
Tie in a slim hackle wing with Lateral Scale and Krystal Flash along the sides.
Add stick-on eyes on each side of the head.
Coat the head with hot glue and shape it while warm.

new.name: Furled Worm
new.description: A worm for redfish and surf perch with lead eyes, a dubbing-loop tail of hare's ear and red Ice Dub that wiggles, and a saddle hackle collar.
new.fishing_tips: Drag it slowly along the bottom near sand bars and troughs.
mats: Natural hare's ear dubbing in a loop, twisted and furled
steps: Tie the dumbbell eyes on so the hook rides up.
Spin hare's ear in a dubbing loop, twist it tight and let it furl into a worm tail.
Dub a short Ice Dub body.
Wind a saddle collar, coat the wraps with UV resin and finish.

new.name: Magic Goby
new.description: A sea trout goby built with the Petitjean Magic Head technique, which flares the fibres at the head for a lot of movement in shallow water.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it slowly in shallow estuary water in spring.
mats: Petitjean Magic Head of CDC or fibres, reverse tied
steps: Tie in a soft tail.
Dub a slim body.
Tie in the head fibres pointing forward, then fold them back to flare them.
Add eyes and finish.

new.name: Striper Dragon
new.description: A simplified Catherwood-style striper fly with a bucktail and grizzly hackle body, pearl Flashabou, a spun deer belly hair head and holographic eyes.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on a sinking line and strip it through bait schools.
mats: Deer belly hair, spun and trimmed
steps: Tie in a layer of white bucktail.
Add grizzly hackles on each side with Flashabou between.
Spin deer belly hair at the front and trim to a round head.
Glue holographic eyes into the head.

new.name: Lunch Money
new.description: A rabbit strip streamer with painted lead eyes, sili legs and a Laser Dub head that jigs and swims, a favourite for trout and bass.
new.fishing_tips: Strip and pause along banks; it dives on the pause.
steps: Tie the lead eyes behind the hook eye.
Tie in a barred rabbit strip tail.
Add sili legs along the sides.
Build a full Laser Dub head and brush it back.

new.name: Fat Head Squishy
new.description: A translucent streamer built from layered Bull Frog and Starburst dubbing with a UV resin shell, so it glides and darts like a slow-sinking jerkbait.
new.fishing_tips: Twitch it and pause; it glides side to side.
mats: Bull Frog dubbing in white, yellow and pale olive
Starburst dubbing in pearl and golden peacock
steps: Tie in a short pearl web tail.
Tie in clumps of dubbing fibre in layers, yellow under white, with flash.
Trim to a fat-headed baitfish shape.
Add eyes and coat the head with a thin UV resin shell.

new.name: Chocolate Thunder
new.description: A foam-back emerger with a flashy dubbed body, a wire rib and a packing-foam wing case, built to hang in the surface film.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the film to fish taking emergers.
steps: Tie in the wire and dub a slim body.
Rib the body.
Tie in the foam strip as a short wing case.
Dub the thorax, coat lightly with resin and finish.

new.name: Cream Midge Larva
new.description: A plain midge larva with a white or cream thread abdomen and a black thorax, a year-round tailwater fly.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep under a heavier nymph on tailwaters from late fall through spring.
mats: White, light tan or light grey 70 denier
steps: Wrap a slim, smooth thread abdomen around the bend.
Add a fine rib if you want segmentation.
Build a small black thorax.
Whip finish and coat thinly.

new.name: Bass Jig Fly
new.description: A fly version of a jig-and-pig: a jig hook with large lead eyes, a magnum rabbit strip trailer, a dense collar of long rubber legs and a dubbing head. It rides point up.
new.fishing_tips: Let it hit the bottom and hop it around rocks and timber; the legs pulse on the pause.
steps: Tie on the dumbbell eyes so the hook rides up.
Tie in a magnum rabbit strip trailer without fouling it.
Tie a dense collar of rubber legs around the shank.
Dub a durable head and finish.

new.name: Olive Sculpin
new.description: A sculpin with a barred olive rabbit tail and body, partridge pectoral fins and a Fish-Skull sculpin helmet.
new.fishing_tips: Dead-drift or strip it near the bottom.
steps: Tie in a rabbit strip tail.
Wind a second rabbit strip forward for the body.
Tie in partridge feathers on each side as fins.
Glue on the sculpin helmet.

new.name: Grasset's Flats Minnow
new.description: A flats baitfish on a bent hook with an olive cactus chenille body, bead chain eyes and an olive-over-white bucktail wing topped with peacock herl.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it over grass and sand for snook, reds and seatrout.
mats: Standard saltwater hook, #4–2/0, bent to shape
steps: Bend the shank slightly and tie on the bead chain.
Wrap a cactus chenille body.
Tie in white then olive bucktail with flash between.
Top with peacock herl and finish.

new.name: Grassett's Snook Minnow
new.description: A small, quick snook fly with a white EP fibre tail, a white Estaz body and gold bead chain eyes.
new.fishing_tips: Work it tight to mangroves and dock lights.
mats: White EP fibre with pearl Flashabou
steps: Tie on the bead chain eyes.
Tie in a white EP tail with a few strands of flash.
Wrap Estaz forward.
Figure-eight around the eyes and finish.

new.name: EP Ghost Shrimp
new.description: A pale shrimp with tan EP fibre body and wing, pearl flash, Bonecrusher legs and mono eyes, for bonefish over light sand.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it in short twitches where the bottom is pale.
mats: Small nickel brass or bead chain eyes
steps: Tie on the weighted eyes.
Tie in flash and mono eyes at the bend.
Build the body and rib it, adding legs.
Tie in a tan wing and glue the head.

new.name: Mr. Wiggly
new.description: A foam beetle-style bug with a green Loco Foam body, an Ice Dub underbody, two sets of sili legs and a yellow foam hot spot, for bass and big trout.
new.fishing_tips: Plop it near banks and twitch the legs.
mats: Silver or smoke grey sili legs
steps: Dub an Ice Dub underbody.
Tie the foam body down in segments.
Add the two sets of legs.
Tie a yellow foam hot spot on top.

new.name: Red Ned
new.description: A one-material fly version of the Ned rig: a gold jig bomb bead, a mono weed guard and a brown Ice Dub chenille body.
new.fishing_tips: Drag it slowly along the bottom with long pauses.
mats: Brown Ice Dub chenille, leaving a tail
steps: Slide on the jig bomb.
Tie in the weed guard.
Tie in the chenille with a short tail and wrap forward.
Close the weed guard and finish.

new.name: Butt Monkey
new.description: An articulated rabbit streamer with marabou undertails, satin chenille underbodies, dumbbell eyes and a Carnivore Dub head.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it hard and pause for big trout and bass.
steps: Tie the rear hook with marabou, chenille and a rabbit wing.
Join it to the front hook.
Tie the front section the same way with dumbbell eyes.
Build a dubbed head and brush it out.

new.name: Bow River Bugger
new.description: A woolly bugger with a sculpin-style deer hair head: marabou tail with blue flash, olive chenille, grizzly hackle, a natural deer collar and a white deer head.
new.fishing_tips: Swing or strip it near the bottom in rocky runs.
mats: White deer hair, spun and trimmed
steps: Tie in the tail and flash.
Wrap the chenille, palmer the hackle and rib it.
Spin a natural deer collar.
Spin white deer hair and trim a flat head.

new.name: Balanced Minnow
new.description: A white minnow balanced on a dressmaker pin so it hangs level, with a marabou tail, pearl palmer chenille body and 3D eyes.
new.fishing_tips: Hang it under an indicator and twitch it.
mats: White tungsten, 3.8–4 mm, on a pin
Super glue gel and UV resin
steps: Glue a bead on a pin and lash it so the bead sits forward.
Tie in a marabou tail and flash.
Wrap palmer chenille forward.
Glue on eyes and coat with resin.

new.name: Hood Rat
new.description: A foam mouse with an Ultra Chenille tail and rabbit strip sides.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it across pools at night.
mats: Tan 2 mm foam, belly and back
steps: Tie in a short Ultra Chenille tail at the bend.
Glue and tie a foam belly under the shank and a foam back on top, in segments.
Glue a rabbit zonker strip along each side so the fur sweeps back.
Trim the foam at the front to a rounded nose and whip finish.

new.name: Glowing Waxworm
new.description: A waxworm with a wooly nylon underbody under glow latex, ribbed with wire and coated with resin.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it under an indicator.
steps: Wrap a few turns of soldering wire for weight.
Build a smooth, tapered wooly nylon underbody.
Wrap glow latex forward in overlapping turns to form segments.
Colour the head with a marker and coat with UV resin.

new.name: Crystal Meth
new.description: A steelhead egg with a Diamond Braid body.
new.fishing_tips: Dead-drift it.
steps: Start the thread behind the eye.
Tie in the Diamond Braid.
Wrap the braid into a round ball, building up the middle.
Tie off and whip finish.
